protocol.description: Sets the communication protocol for the RS-485 port.

address.description: Sets the Modbus address for the meter on the RS-485 network.

baud_rate.description: Sets the baud rate for RS-485 communication.

parity.description: Sets the parity for RS-485 communication.

allowed_values.None: None means no parity bit is used
allowed_values.Even: Even means the number of 1-bits is even
allowed_values.Odd: Odd means the number of 1-bits is odd
